records.title: Artificial Intelligence in Spinal Cord Stimulation and Neuromodulation: A Narrative Review of Clinical Applications, Emerging Evidence, and Future Directions

decisions.notes: Publisher full text checked on 2026-09-28. Narrative review of selection, programming and closed-loop SCS with no newly enrolled cohort, model training, train/test split or article-level clinical outcome. Authors note small heterogeneous studies and missing external validation. ECAP is neural feedback, not a direct pain measure.

updates.ограничения: Narrative literature review without a newly enrolled cohort, systematic selection protocol, article-level prediction metric or external validation. The authors describe small retrospective and heterogeneous AI-SCS studies and a lack of large prospective multicenter randomized trials. Claims linking ECAP feedback or other signals to analgesia are authors' synthesis, not a direct ECAP pain measure or evidence from this review.
